extracted.stage: Divorce financial remedy proceedings, next hearing listed
extracted.summary: A solicitor is enquiring about a £35,500 loan to fund counsel, a forensic accountant and legal costs for the applicant in a divorce where around £759,500 of assets are in dispute, with a hearing at Bristol Family Court on 21 October.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client; we have logged the details you provided. To progress our review we will need confirmation of your client's identity and address, a breakdown of the costs to be funded and any costs estimate to final hearing, and supporting evidence of the assets in dispute including property valuations, mortgage balances and pension figures. It would also help to have the case number, the nature of the hearing listed for 21 October, and confirmation of whether any other funding or legal services payment order is in place or being sought. We will send our current criteria and application form separately. A member of the team will be in touch once we have reviewed what you send.
